after: (Detrans. ?) erneuert werden, von neuem gefeiert werden;
rationale: The celebration is the subject undergoing renewal, with no expressed renewer. Clarify the inherited active-worded gloss erneuern, von neuem machen as the patient-oriented event meaning; preserve its inherited uncertainty marker.

summary: The single occurrence is already the inherited Detransitive Infectum example at 57/235. i ḥafle is the event undergoing renewal and the feminine form agrees with it; no agent is expressed.
The source explicitly annotates (+det), supporting the Detransitive analysis, though an editorial uncertainty marker in the inherited gloss is retained rather than silently removed.
The gloss clarification changes argument orientation from doing renewal to undergoing renewal/being celebrated anew. It introduces no new sense, stem or form.
Retain the inherited base forms mǧadəd/miǧadəd and the source spelling gmiǧaddo. Neither an unattested active paradigm nor a ritual technical sense is inferred.
Does II also have a productive active use, and should the inherited Detransitive question mark be removed after speaker confirmation? Only the attested event-renewal construction is supported here.
